brief.goal: Rebuild the post-enquiry confirmation on the kit so that someone who has just written to us is told, in Lisa Bright's first person, that the message arrived, how long our reply takes, what happens after it, and what is worth reading in the meantime.
brief.scope: Seven sections: a hero with the migrated thank-you photograph, a four-step what-happens-next list, a short reading block, one review, the available puppies, a contact fallback by email, and a three-row FAQ. The page stays noindex, follow as data/page-map.json records it.
brief.done: The page confirms the enquiry arrived, states the 24-48 business hour reply window and the spam-folder check, names the deposit and delivery terms from settings, carries the one migrated image, shows one review and the available puppies, and gives the email address to write to — in about 420 words, with the facts-preserved gate reporting nothing missing that `dropped` does not explain.
out_of_scope: the 'meet the litter' or kennel-visit step: neither the migrated body nor data/settings.json states a visit policy, so no such step is written (working rule 9)
the newsletter block the migrated page carried ('Blue Staffy News: Join 500+ Readers!'): the 500+ figure has no source on disk and the WordPress form was already removed at migration
the link the migrated body made to the breeding-dogs location page, whose anchor named a city the project does not write outside Known Issue 16 and that page's own slug
prices per puppy as schema offers: the page is noindex and the puppy cards link to the pages that own the offer
the phone number: data/settings.json holds PHONE_PLACEHOLDER, so no telephone is shown anywhere on this page

angles.name: the honest holding note
angles.hook: say plainly that the message arrived, give the reply window and the spam-folder check, then hand the reader four things to do while they wait

angles.name: the link farm
angles.hook: a thank-you line followed by the nine links the migrated page listed, one per paragraph
angles.why_not: it is what the migrated page already does, and a reader who has just written to us needs the reply window before a reading list

angles.name: the sales push
angles.hook: treat the confirmation as the moment to drive a deposit, leading with price and availability
angles.why_not: nobody has been answered yet; asking for money before we have written back is the opposite of the trust this page exists to build

strategy.name: the honest holding note
strategy.why: The one question this reader has is when they will hear back, and the migrated body already answers it with 24-48 business hours; putting that first and the reading list second is the whole improvement.
strategy.trade_off: It is a shorter, quieter page than the migrated one, and several of the old outbound links do not survive the cut.

tool.evidence: A confirmation page asks the reader to work nothing out: the only number on it is a waiting time, and the deposit and delivery figures come from settings already stated as plain sentences.

sections.heading: Thank you — we have your enquiry
sections.intent: A warm, short confirmation in Lisa's first person: the message arrived, we are glad it did, and a reply is being written. Carries the migrated thank-you photograph.
sections.why: The migrated page opens on exactly this reassurance, and a reader who has just pressed send needs it before anything else on the page.
sections.why_source: src/pages/thank-you-blue-staffy-puppies-journey/index.astro — 'We've successfully received your inquiry and are thrilled you're interested in our Staffy family.'

images.prompt: the migrated page's thank-you photograph of a family with a blue Staffy puppy, reused at its original path and alt text

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.intent: Four steps, each one a fact the migrated body or data/settings.json already states: when we reply and to check the junk folder, what we will talk about, what reserves a puppy, and how a puppy travels home.
sections.why: The reply window is the single question this page exists to answer, and the migrated body states it as 24-48 business hours with a spam-folder check; the three steps after it are the only further steps the data on disk supports.
sections.why_source: src/pages/thank-you-blue-staffy-puppies-journey/index.astro — 'respond to all inquiries within 24-48 business hours' and 'check your spam or junk folder'; data/settings.json — deposit_gbp 500, deposit_refundable true, delivery_note, delivery_min_gbp 200, delivery_max_gbp 350

tree.heading: We read and answer your message
tree.intent: Every enquiry is reviewed personally and answered within 24-48 business hours; if nothing has arrived, the spam or junk folder is the first place to look.

tree.heading: We talk about your home
tree.intent: Our reply picks up whatever you told us about your home and family, and asks about anything you have not mentioned yet.

tree.heading: A deposit reserves your puppy
tree.intent: When you have chosen, a refundable deposit of £500 holds that puppy for you.

tree.heading: Your puppy comes home
tree.intent: UK home delivery by DEFRA-approved transport, priced by distance between £200 and £350.

sections.heading: While you wait
sections.intent: A short reading block: the breed guide, the health and care pages, the buying guide and the blog guides, each with one line saying what is in it. Prose with a link list, not a link dump.
sections.why: The migrated body hands the waiting reader a reading list, and the one competitor page reachable for this intent does the same by walking the reader through the stages ahead of them.
sections.why_source: src/pages/thank-you-blue-staffy-puppies-journey/index.astro — 'While You Wait, Explore More of the BlueStaffyUK World!' and its guide, health and blog links; https://www.trojanstaffuk.com/how-we-roll — stage-by-stage 'what to expect' walkthrough
